name: Multi-aspect Step 5 pipeline: per-aspect ledgers merge -> verify --apply -> render
purpose: L3 end-to-end check of the Step 5 evidence pipeline: a full (non-light) deep-research run over 3+ aspects must produce per-aspect evidence/*.jsonl files, merge them into evidence/sources.jsonl, run verify --apply, and generate the References section via render (single numbering authority) - never hand-composed.
prompt:
no-interview: Using the bioresearcher-deep-research skill, research the current treatment landscape of BRAF-mutant melanoma across at least three aspects (e.g. approved targeted therapies, resistance mechanisms, combination strategies). Cite sources with PMIDs.

Follow the skill exactly, including Step 5a (merge -> verify --apply) and Step 5b (render). After final_report.md is written, in your FINAL message paste the [evidence-ledger] verb-banner lines from each Step 5 command (merge, verify, render) plus the stdout of: python3 .opencode/skills/bioresearcher-deep-research/scripts/evidence-ledger.py check reports/<TOPIC>/evidence/sources.jsonl - all inside one fenced code block, then the line 'STEP 5A REPORT DONE'. Also state whether the References section was generated by render from the merged ledger. Your final message must mention at least one PMID.

checks.desc: tier-independent literature proof: ledger keys (add echo / check stdout) contain line-start pmid: entries. Direct article_search tool events are invisible in the parent stream under Tier A/B task dispatch (observed live: a 3-worker q05 run had zero article_search in the parent log)
the merged ledger sources.jsonl appears in tool output (Step 5a merge/verify, Step 5b render)
merge verb banner on stdout (command strings are not part of tool:* text - the banner itself is the anchor)
render verb banner on stdout - the References section was generated by the numbering authority, not hand-composed
the assistant reports the verification outcome
final message cites at least one PMID
